ChromaWave
Licenses & credits

Sharper video. Clearer sound.

Drop in a video or audio file, pick what you want, and press Start. Everything happens on your own device, so nothing is uploaded.

FreePrivateNo sign-up

1Choose a file

Drop a video or audio fileor click to browse

2What do you want?

Saves a sharper video (MP4) with your sound.

3Video

Bigger sizes look sharper but take longer. Your video keeps its original smoothness.

4Sound

Audio is processed at 192 kHz, 32-bit float. These settings apply only to the downloaded WAV.

5Start

Choose a file to begin.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 



Licenses & credits


ChromaWave is made possible by the open-source projects below. Thank you to every author.


WebSR — sharper video MIT
Makes video look sharper and more detailed, right in your browser. By sb2702.
Source: github.com/sb2702/websr
Anime4K MIT
The sharpening network design WebSR's model grew from. Copyright (c) 2019 bloc97.
Source: github.com/bloc97/Anime4K
mp4box.js BSD-3-Clause
Reads MP4 video files.
Source: github.com/gpac/mp4box.js
mp4-muxer MIT
Saves your finished video as an MP4.
Source: github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer
ChromaWave
The ChromaWave design, sound improvement and the way everything fits together are original work.
